HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   C. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

5. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   D. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   B. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

14. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   C. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

16. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
